description: This Java source file defines the class 'ValueLinkServices' which provides a set of static methods for integrating with ValueLink gift card and payment services. The class includes methods for creating keys, testing encryption, activating, linking, disabling, redeeming, reloading, inquiring balances, transaction histories, refunds, voids, and other gift card management operations. It also contains wrapper methods for purchase, reload, release, and refund operations, along with helper functions for handling properties and timeout reversals.

classes.name: ValueLinkServices
classes.description: Service class providing static methods for ValueLink gift card and payment operations, including key management, activation, linking, disabling, redeeming, reloading, inquiries, refunds, and transaction reversals.

methods.name: createKeys
methods.description: Generates and displays new public/private keys through the ValueLink API.

methods.name: testKekEncryption
methods.description: Tests KEK encryption and decryption operations by encrypting or decrypting a test string or bytes.

methods.name: assignWorkingKey
methods.description: Changes or assigns a new working key with ValueLink, updating stored key information.

methods.name: activate
methods.description: Activates a gift card with specified details such as promo code, card number, PIN, currency, and amount.

methods.name: linkPhysicalCard
methods.description: Links a virtual card to a physical card, enabling the physical card to be used alongside the virtual card.

methods.name: disablePin
methods.description: Disables the PIN on a specified gift card.

methods.name: redeem
methods.description: Redeems a specified amount from a gift card, updating balances accordingly.

methods.name: reload
methods.description: Reloads a gift card with a specified amount.

methods.name: balanceInquire
methods.description: Inquires the current balance of a gift card.

methods.name: transactionHistory
methods.description: Retrieves the transaction history for a gift card.

methods.name: refund
methods.description: Refunds an amount to a gift card.

methods.name: voidRedeem
methods.description: Voids a previous redeem transaction.

methods.name: voidRefund
methods.description: Voids a previous refund transaction.

methods.name: voidActivate
methods.description: Voids a previous activation transaction.

methods.name: timeOutReversal
methods.description: Performs a timeout reversal for certain transactions based on the interface type.

methods.name: setTimeoutReversal
methods.description: Helper to set up a timeout reversal service call with proper context and rollback setup.

methods.name: getProperties
methods.description: Retrieves payment configuration properties from a specified configuration file.

methods.name: giftCardProcessor
methods.description: Wrapper for processing gift card transactions such as redemption with additional handling.

methods.name: giftCardRelease
methods.description: Wrapper for releasing (voiding) a gift card redemption.

methods.name: giftCardRefund
methods.description: Wrapper for processing a gift card refund.

methods.name: giftCardPurchase
methods.description: Wrapper for processing a gift card purchase/activation, including fulfillment record creation and email notification.

methods.name: giftCardReload
methods.description: Wrapper for reloading an existing gift card, including fulfillment recording and error handling.
